request: Every page on the site shares the same layout, but the footer is just a copyright line. Change the shared layout so the footer also carries a link to the site's about page, and let that link show up on every page. Make sure the site still builds and the pages render.

plan.goal: Add a link to the about page to the shared footer so every page offers it.

scope.title: About link in the shared footer
scope.description: Extend the footer in src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro with an anchor to /about/ labelled "About" (or similar), so the link appears on every page that uses the layout.

steps.description:
Add an anchor with href="/about/" inside the footer's

or immediately after it in src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro.
Give the link a readable label and keep the existing copyright text intact.
Build the site and confirm the home page and about page both render with the footer link present.

out_of_scope.item: Redesigning the footer or its styling
out_of_scope.reason: The task is to add one link to the existing footer; changing the footer's visual design is a styling task of its own.

out_of_scope.item: Adding the same link to the header navigation
out_of_scope.reason: The header nav already lists the about page; adding a second nav entry would duplicate it.
